parameters.WIDTH: 8..16; actual RTL unit/peers tested at 8 and 16

contract: Source is a held batch of naturally aligned prepared independent fields in one 256-bit Control; only one Request or Response class per batch
Only confirmed field tenure is supported; NOP padding may be zero; nonzero FC fields use a separate publisher and are rejected here
512-bit source tag bus carries up to eight 64-bit tags in field order; output carries at most four and zeros unused slots in Auth mode
Keep source Control/tags/valid unchanged until o_source_taken; o_taken confirms only the current output partition entered the downstream header FIFO
Capacity and Auth/shared mode are from the same real port and stable after initialization throughout a reset epoch
Partition according to total physical capacity, not available credits; real balance/catch/payload checks remain at actual wire transfer
Retain original sector alignment/field bits and data order; no change to LEN, OFFSET, LAST, TAG, status or individual transaction tenure
Downstream Data/BE source ordering is unchanged; source data acceptance remains separately accounted by actual Tx SRAM buffers
If the earliest individual field exceeds capacity, assert o_shortfall without confirming source or skipping to later transactions
verified_goal_boundary: Oversized groups of individually feasible fields can complete with actual CMD/Data capacities of one
This is not a general UPLI formatter, arbitrary multi-beat transaction splitter or per-VC scheduler
Source-selected Single-Beat read responses are distinct from rewriting already-issued Multi-Beat transfers; arbitrary Write/Atomic splitting is not inferred
open: Full UPLI encoding/forwarding and per-VC selection
Full protocol/resource induction and process STA
Complete Endpoint and Switch IP goal
